maintenance_led.reason: Revenue mainly from selling new vacation ownership intervals, plus financing, management fees and exchange/rental; not repair or replacement of installed items.

publicly_funded.reason: Customers are private consumers buying Marriott, Sheraton, Westin and Hyatt vacation club ownership and travel services.

serial_acquirer.reason: Grows mainly through timeshare sales; Vistana and Hyatt Vacation Ownership were a few large deals, not a steady roll-up.

mission_critical.reason: Vacation ownership is discretionary leisure; owners hold contracts and exit is hard, but it isn't operationally critical to customers.

notes: Mission-critical is borderline: timeshare contracts are hard to exit, but the service is discretionary.
